item.title: Cleopatra’s eye makeup secret? Ancient Egyptians used lead-based kohl
item.description: In ancient Egypt, kohl was more than just a cosmetic; it served dual purposes, enhancing beauty while protecting the eyes. Studies indicate that its ingredients could boost immune responses, making it a valuable tool for health. Both men and women embraced the use of black and green powders, and ancient texts highlight the fusion of cosmetics with medicine, revealing the intricate beliefs surrounding beauty and wellness in that era. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Night Plane review – join the jumbo jet to hell in this indie horror head trip
item.description: Liquid Static Studio; PC You take on the role of flight attendant in this clever and absorbing retro-style game that veers from daft horror spoof to genuinely disturbing There was always something creepy about the job-simulator genre. All those mindless automatons queueing up to use your bus, bar or bed store, or whatever workplace you are trapped in for the duration of the game. The endless repetitive tasks. The emptiness of the world beyond your corporate existence. item.description: The rapper lends the NFL a veneer of credibility but is unlikely to push back on the establishment figures who run the league On Monday the NFL named Jay-Z as the headliner for this season’s Super Bowl half-time show. His company, Roc Nation, produces the show under a 2019 deal reportedly worth $5m a year, and the agreement was extended for another five years in 2024. NFL commissioner Roger Goodell said his one request when the partnership began was that Jay-Z “ take the stage himself one day “. Goodell’s wish makes total sense: Jay-Z is the perfect choice for the half-time show, and that’s… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: ‘Fear is contagious’: why horror shows are taking over the New York stage
item.description: Hit London plays 2:22, Paranormal Activity and A Ghost in Your Ear are now spooking audiences on and off Broadway amid high demand for communal experiences As we escaped the restrictions of the pandemic, with many also trying to escape the smartphone addiction that was exacerbated by it, there was widespread desire for the in-person communal experience. It was a slow crawl back with casualties along the way but as the Hollywood and Broadway box office return to pre-pandemic levels this year, our craving for IRL thrills appears to be stronger than ever. item.title: Is It Too Late to Make a Run for It? by Judi Dench review – whatever you do, don’t call her a ‘national treasure’
item.description: The actor waxes lyrical on directors, dildos and why she hates being referred to as though she’s a dusty old relic In the late 1950s, Judi Dench was invited to meet a major Hollywood producer about a possible career in the film business. item.title: Everest: The Other Side review – couple’s climb on the mountain’s toughest face comes with tricky moral questions over their lofty ambitions
item.description: Immersive portrait of mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson as they seek to become the first people to ski down Everest’s north face With some of its showings in the huge Imax format, this National Geographic-backed documentary feels like a callback to the early, glory days of large-format cinema when it was all about spectacle and scale, turning footage of natural-world wonders into an immersive experience. item.title: El único pueblo de España excomulgado por la Iglesia ya tiene lista su fiesta para celebrarlo
item.description: En cualquier película de terror, el forastero que pregunta por la maldición del pueblo no sobrevive al segundo acto. En Trasmoz pasa justo lo contrario: el foráneo que llega pregunta, paga cuatro euros y recibe un susto con entrada incluida. Este pueblo del Moncayo, con menos de un centenar de vecinos, es el único de España excomulgado por la Iglesia y lo celebra. La Asociación Cultural El Embrujo de Trasmoz organiza otra vez la Luz de las Ánimas , una jornada que arranca a las 10:30 y se alarga hasta pasada la medianoche . Castigos por leña y agua.
